verdict.rationale: Plaid Link is explicitly documented as the client-side hosted widget that lets users connect their bank without the developer building institution UI, paired with server-side session/token creation (public_token/access_token flow) shown in SDKs and Sandbox docs. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer report confirming the end-to-end token exchange experience, and no explicit token-exchange code snippet in this pack (only Sandbox/public_token creation and general Link description).
